source_line: HubSpot portal 4451852 · CRM contacts + Marketing Email Analytics API
intro_html: Built directly from HubSpot's CRM API and marketing-email analytics, contact-level lifecycle stages, workflow enrollment lists, and per-email send data, as an independent read alongside Tim's own workflow-reporting build. Enrollment, lifecycle movement and audience were pulled on Oct 14, 2026; email performance on Oct 13, 2026. Movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date. The program went live Aug 18 per the Asana launch milestone, and most contacts enrolled in bulk runs from Aug 31.

lifecycle.note_html: Contacts enrolled in a Fall 2026 nurture workflow whose lifecyclestage advanced (entered MQL, SQL, Opportunity or Customer) after the day they enrolled. Enrollment comes from each workflow's history (an ever-enrolled list per workflow), not from the nurture_track tag, which is written only when a contact completes the full workflow. Stage entries on the enrollment day itself cannot be ordered against the enrollment and are not counted.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts moved to a new lifecycle stage after they enrolled
tiles.cap: 38 in Inquiry Journeys and 8 in Inkwell, out of 6,124 enrollments across the four workflows with contacts. Great First Eight and Agnostic have none yet. 40 are MQL entries; the other 6 entered SQL, Opportunity or Customer only. 6 reached Customer (2 in Inquiry Journeys, 4 in Inkwell).

tiles.label: Contacts enrolled across the four workflows
tiles.cap: 5,639 in progress and 485 no longer active (removed by a suppression list or completed). Inquiry Journeys 3,316, Inkwell 1,878, Agnostic 767, Great First Eight 163. World History has none. 93% of Inquiry Journeys enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31.

tiles.label: Of Inquiry Journeys contacts moved after enrolling, against 0.4% in Inkwell
tiles.cap: 38 of 3,316 in Inquiry Journeys and 8 of 1,878 in Inkwell. 39 of the 46 enrolled in the Aug 31 bulk run, which has had six weeks. Most October enrollees have had under a week, so these rates will rise.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts had already entered a lifecycle stage before they enrolled
tiles.cap: 114 in Inquiry Journeys and 188 in Inkwell entered MQL or a later stage between Aug 6 and their enrollment, and another 36 did so on the enrollment day itself. For these contacts the content conversion that made them MQL is likely also what enrolled them, so reaching MQL cannot be counted as a nurture result. MQL to SQL is a cleaner test of the nurture.

by_program.moved_note: 38 after the enrollment day: 35 entered MQL, plus 3 whose only new stage was SQL, Opportunity or Customer. 5 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.

8 after the enrollment day: 5 entered MQL and 3 entered Customer only. 4 of the 8 are contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close. 29 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.
No stage entries after the enrollment day. 7 contacts entered a stage before they enrolled.
No stage entries after the enrollment day. 525 enrolled in the week of Oct 5, so most have had under a week. 1 enrolled contact has no enrollment date yet.
No contacts enrolled and no emails sent. Cause unconfirmed: the enrollment audience may be empty or the workflow may be off.

coverage.title: What is and is not counted
coverage.html: Enrollment counts come from lists that read each workflow's status, so every program is covered, including Great First Eight and Agnostic, which the nurture_track tag never captured. Two limits. 35 contacts enrolled after Oct 13 (Inquiry Journeys 5, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) have no Nurture Enrollment Date yet, so they are counted as enrolled but cannot be counted as moved. Stage at enrollment and the converting form are not recorded yet: the three new contact properties fill in only for contacts who enroll from now on, so movement is split by date, not by the stage a contact started at.

portfolio.note_html: Eight weeks after the Aug 18 launch, delivery has jumped sharply since the Oct 6 check (9,478 to 12,680), driven mainly by Inquiry Journeys, Inkwell and Great First Eight all crossing module 4 into full send volume for the first time. Agnostic's suppression problem has worsened again: the program now suppresses 142% of what it delivers, up from 130% last week, with module 1 alone now suppressing more than 3x its own delivery. That is worth checking before reading anything else into Agnostic's numbers.

tiles.label: Total delivered across the portfolio, up from 9,478 on Oct 6
tiles.cap: IJ 8,956 · Inkwell 2,850 · GF8 405 · Agnostic 469 · World History 0. Inquiry Journeys alone is 71% of all delivery.

tiles.label: Unique open rate portfolio-wide, bots excluded
tiles.cap: 3,319 unique opens on 12,680 delivered. By program: Inkwell 27.1%, IJ 26.5%, GF8 22.5%, Agnostic 18.6%. Click rate is 1.7% and unsubscribe 0.32%, inside the under-1% guardrail.

tiles.label: Nurture emails that have sent at all
tiles.cap: 16 of the 49 registered emails have no send data yet: all 4 World History emails, modules 7 and 8 across Inquiry Journeys (both tracks, including a duplicate module 7 record), modules 6 through 8 across Inkwell (both tracks), and Agnostic's module 6. The ones showing 1 or 2 sends are test sends, not audience delivery.

tiles.label: Agnostic suppression rate against delivered, the worst in the portfolio
tiles.cap: 666 suppressed against 469 delivered program wide. Module 1 alone suppresses more than 3x what it delivers, 563 suppressed against 186 delivered. Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause is not confirmable through the API.

workflows_note_html: Confirmed by Kelsey as the only workflows currently nurturing contacts this fall; everything else in the portal's nurture history is retired. HubSpot's Automation/Workflow objects aren't exposed through the connected API, so enabled/paused state and branch logic still need a manual check in HubSpot, the performance on each card comes from the flow's marketing emails instead.

programs.label: Inquiry Journeys
programs.note_html: Leadership has sent five modules now, four at full volume (1,125, 1,160, 1,079 and 874 delivered) and one still too thin to read (23 on module 5). Classroom has also reached four full-volume modules (1,314, 1,248, 1,178 and 934 delivered); module 5 remains a test send only (2 delivered). Open rate holds in the low-to-high twenties across modules 1 through 4, peaking at 30.8% on Classroom module 3. This program carries 71% of portfolio delivery and has 3,316 enrolled contacts, of whom 38 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (1.1%). 93% enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31, so the cohort is six weeks old and the October enrollees much younger.

programs.label: Inkwell
programs.note_html: Still the strongest engagement in the portfolio on open rate (27.1%, best of any program) and the lowest suppression rate by a wide margin (3.8% of delivered, against 20.1% portfolio-wide). Leadership module 4 jumped to the best single open-rate result anywhere this week at 35.4% (74 of 209), narrowly ahead of Leadership module 1's 35.1%. Program-wide unsubscribe sits at 0.49% (14 of 2,850), under the 1% guardrail. Of 1,878 enrolled contacts, 8 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (0.4%); 188 had already entered MQL before they enrolled.

programs.label: Great First Eight
programs.note_html: Modules 1 through 4 now all have real volume (128, 118, 89 and 66 delivered); modules 5 and 6 show 2 sends each, which are tests. Clicks are 3 across the whole program, so no reliable click read is possible yet. Unsubscribe reads 0.74% (3 of 405), under the 1% guardrail but still thin enough that one or two people move the number. 163 contacts are enrolled and none has moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling.

programs.label: Agnostic
programs.note_html: Suppression is now even more dominant: 666 suppressed against 469 delivered program wide, suppressing 142% of what it delivers, up from 130% last week. Module 1 alone suppresses 563 against just 186 delivered, more than 3x its own delivery and sharply worse than last week's ratio. Open rate is 18.6% program wide; module 5 remains the strongest performer at 23.3%, though its volume (30 delivered) is unchanged from last week. Worth checking the suppression lists and frequency caps on this track immediately; the cause is not confirmable from the API.

programs.label: World History
programs.note_html: Unchanged across every check since Aug 31. All four World History emails exist and carry the correct nurture property, but none has ever sent. Two possible causes, neither confirmable through the API: the enrollment audience is empty, or the workflow is not switched on. No contacts are enrolled (its ever-enrolled list is empty), so it shows no movement. The nurture_track__world_history property does not exist, but the enrollment and exit lists read workflow status and do not need it.

emails.note_html: Click-to-open rate (clicks ÷ opens, excluding bots) directly from HubSpot's marketing-email analytics, a purer read on content quality than open rate, since it isolates people who opened and then found something worth clicking. Listed: emails with real volume (20+ delivered as of the last pull); everything thinner is too early to rank. CT = Classroom Track (teacher-facing), LT = Leadership Track (admin-facing).
emails.callout_html: Inkwell's Classroom Track emails continue to convert opens to clicks much better than its Leadership Track (10.5% average CTOR across four CT emails vs. 4.4% across four LT emails, a gap that has narrowed from 3.3x to 2.4x as modules 2 through 4 pick up volume). Inquiry Journeys shows a similar but smaller gap (7.1% CT vs. 4.8% LT), pulled down on both sides by module 4's still-low CTOR now that it has reached full volume for the first time.

audience.role_note_html: Split by the contact's Role property for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow. "Admin/Leadership" groups School Leader, District Leader, and Coach/Specialist; "Other/Unassigned" is everyone without a classified role. Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell are mostly administrators and coaches, Great First Eight is mostly teachers, and Agnostic is almost entirely unclassified.
audience.source_note_html: Original source (first-touch attribution) for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow.

movement.html: Contacts enrolled in more than one workflow, counted from the four workflow history exports on Oct 13 (Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell share 92 of them). Cross-product re-routing is expected, so these contacts appear in more than one program above. This count is carried forward until the next set of history exports.

open_items.html: Inquiry Journeys carries 71% of delivery and 38 of its 3,316 enrolled contacts (1.1%) moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling. Inkwell moved 8 of 1,878 (0.4%). 93% of Inquiry Journeys enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31 and 524 Inkwell and Agnostic contacts enrolled in the week of Oct 5, so the cohorts are different ages. This is not an email-performance problem: open and click rates are healthy. The open question is whether the content is moving contacts who were not already MQL.

Agnostic now suppresses significantly more than it delivers, and the gap is widening. Program wide, 666 suppressed against 469 delivered (142%, against 20% portfolio-wide), up from 130% last week. Module 1 alone suppresses more than 3x what it sends (563 suppressed, 186 delivered). Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause cannot be confirmed through the API.

Module 4 crossed into real send volume this week across Inquiry Journeys, Inkwell and Great First Eight, all for the first time. Inquiry Journeys Leadership (874 delivered) and Classroom (934), Inkwell Leadership (209) and Classroom (99), and Great First Eight (66) all moved past the 20-delivered test threshold. Module 5 is still mostly thin: Inquiry Journeys Leadership sits at just 23 delivered, and Inkwell and GF8's later modules remain 2-send tests. Agnostic's module 5, which reached real volume last week, held flat at 30 delivered. Modules 6 through 8 in Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell have not sent at all. Eight weeks post launch on a spaced cadence, more volume is still coming in, but most of the portfolio's history is still early modules.

World History has still never sent an email, unchanged since Aug 31: 0 delivered across all 4 emails and 0 contacts enrolled. Either the enrollment audience is empty or the workflow is not live, and neither is readable via API. The missing nurture_track__world_history property no longer blocks tracking, because the lists read workflow status.

The new enrollment fields are not live for everyone yet. 35 contacts enrolled after Oct 13 have no enrollment date, and Nurture Stage at Enrollment and Nurture Enrollment Form are empty for every contact until the workflow steps run. Until then movement is split by date, not by the stage a contact started at, and a fresh set of workflow history exports will fill the 35.

Tim's reporting-structure rebuild is still open and is now the binding constraint. It was due Aug 17 and is eight weeks overdue in Asana as of Oct 13. This page is a workaround built from raw API pulls; the Tier 1/2/3 reporting it is standing in for is what the Dec 18 program end and Jan 11 postmortem are supposed to read from.
Confirm enabled/paused state and branch logic for all 5 flows directly in HubSpot. Still not readable via API.

Query note for the next refresh: the role property stores internal values (teacher, school leader, district leader) that differ from its display labels, and the nurture_track* tag is written only when a workflow completes, so it is not used for counting. Count enrollment from the ever-enrolled and active lists listed in the workflow registry.

footnote_html: Source: HubSpot portal 4451852. CRM contact query API (lifecyclestage v2 stage-entry dates and the Nurture Enrollment Date property, read through each workflow's ever-enrolled and active lists, pulled Oct 14, 2026) and Marketing Email Analytics API (OVERVIEW, per-email, bots excluded, pulled Oct 13, 2026), scoped to the 5 confirmed Fall 2026 nurture programs via the nurture property on MARKETING_EMAIL. Lifecycle movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date (the stage entry must fall after the enrollment day). Email window Jul 30 to Oct 13, 2026. Enrolled counts include contacts who have since been removed or completed. Workflow enabled/paused state is not available via API.
